patthana12.16:1.1: na saraṇaṃ no āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ na noāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ na anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ na āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na āsavañceva na anāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ na anāsavañceva na nocaāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na āsavañceva na āsavavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ na āsavavippayuttañceva na nocaāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ na sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ na anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nasaraṇaduka chagocchakadukaṃ na saraṇaṃ no saññojanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ no ganthaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ no oghaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ no yogaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ no nīvaraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na saraṇaṃ no parāmāsaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nasaraṇaduka mahantaradukaṃ
patthana12.16:2.1: na saraṇaṃ na sārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... saṅkhittaṃ. na saraṇaṃ na
patthana12.16:3.1: cittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na
patthana12.16:4.1: cetasikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na cittasampayuttaṃ
patthana12.16:5.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na cittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ
patthana12.16:7.1: na saraṇaṃ na cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana12.16:8.1: na saraṇaṃ na cittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana12.16:9.1: na saraṇaṃ na cittānuparivattiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana12.16:10.1: na saraṇaṃ na cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ...
patthana12.16:11.1: na saraṇaṃ na cittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... na saraṇaṃ na ajjhattikaṃ
